sources.adapt: Replace single advantage-conditioning pathway with explicitly timed high-level and action-level value branches: before READ, and after subtask/before action. Label independent ψ, VLM θ, expert φ and separate CE/FM/value losses. Render K/V stop-gradient explicitly according to proposal/KI text. Keep return estimates as proposed training targets, not observed results.
sources.must_not_infer: The original drawing itself does not show all loss arrows or stop-gradient markers. Original action-quality conditioning must not be relabeled as a pre-existing READ/WRITE utility mechanism. Our read/write benefit requires paired continuations, not directly copying RECAP action advantage.
